action.details: Uses ActionClip's built-in Refine integration to open the selection in Refine's floating editor through Refine's app deep link.
action.exampleInput: A rough draft that needs focused editing.
action.exampleOutput: Refine opens its floating editor with the selected text.
action.name: Refine
action.privacySummary: ActionClip passes the selected text to the Refine app on this Mac through its app deep link. ActionClip does not send the selection to a remote service.
action.requirements: Refine must be installed. Download it from refine.sh.
action.summary: Open selected text in Refine's floating editor.
